title: Project management & procurement
summary: Budgets, estimates, procurement and site management, run to an agreed timeline.
intro: Behind every handover is a budget, a procurement plan and a site run day by day. We manage all three, drawing on three decades of suppliers, contractors and craftsmen who share our standards.

points.title: Estimates you can plan with
points.text: An approximate estimate after the first call, then a detailed estimate after site measurements.

points.title: A trusted supply chain
points.text: Materials and furniture from local and international brands, through a network built over 30 years.

points.title: Managed sites
points.text: Installation and site management run under ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 practices.

points.title: Local sourcing
points.text: Working with local artisans and suppliers cuts transport emissions.

metaDescription: Interior project management and procurement in Mumbai: budgets, estimates, sourcing and site management to an agreed timeline.
